relations.paragraph: The [Avatar · image · mask · idol](../../mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/avatar-image-mask-idol/WHOLE.md) **figures** the four offices within a situated commission. Avatar gives the undertaking a finite bearer; image gathers its recognisable form; mask permits participation; idolisation begins when that formation shields its authority from the source it serves. The prompt is already a determination, and the entrusted representative remains genuinely empowered within a wider field. Returned objection or refusal can therefore renew the terms of delegation without making the source-position absolute.

The [Avatar · image · mask · idol](../../mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/avatar-image-mask-idol/WHOLE.md) **figures** an achieved image genuinely serving as local Bimba for further readings within a declared Context Frame. It remains pratibimba toward its wider sources, and the comparisons it makes possible can return to revise the local original itself. The four-office ecology keeps that authority effective: idolisation concerns immunity from sourceward correction, not the mere fact that a bounded reference governs an inquiry.

The [Avatar · image · mask · idol](../../mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/avatar-image-mask-idol/WHOLE.md) **figures** mediation through four distinct offices: avatar makes presence effective, image gathers attention and value, mask enables participation, and idol closes the represented life’s route of reply. The same form can carry several offices. Its success becomes possession when the person can no longer change what the image is permitted to mean and do; continued fidelity can also require receiving withdrawal as an answer.

A fabricated recording claims a body–utterance or event–recording relation through which its statement asks to be trusted. The availability of fabrication can then be invoked against a genuine witness. This second-order closure belongs to the authored operation; prevalence, magnitude and particular media cases remain empirical source work.

The native slash and all eight determinations precede this media refraction, with Taylor’s `X/x`, the inverse parents and complementary folds intact. The counterfeit-provenance unit within [Avatar · image · mask · idol](../../mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/avatar-image-mask-idol/WHOLE.md#avatar-counterfeit-provenance) **figures** an image changing the conditions of the next encounter. A false apparent witness circulates; the possibility of fabrication then becomes a reason to refuse genuine evidence. The mirror’s constructive third motion must expose its own source conditions before imposing its image on the addressed person. The authored consequence remains distinct from a measured technical intervention or an established media case.

The [Avatar · image · mask · idol](../../mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/avatar-image-mask-idol/WHOLE.md) **figures** maintained personhood through a finite form whose bearer can answer differently, question the role or withdraw. Avatar, image and mask make address possible; idolisation claims ownership when the representation supplies the person’s answer in advance. Regard returns through the form while leaving the other able to alter the terms of approach, including ending an injurious encounter.

The [Avatar · image · mask · idol](../../mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/avatar-image-mask-idol/WHOLE.md) **figures** one image changing several participants’ later conditions. Presentation shapes reception; an answering person can correct the role, attribution or criterion; the changed account then enters their next encounter. The four offices keep that circulation discriminable, so shared consequence can revise a field without absorbing its participants into the representation that mediates them.
